notes:
# Guard this Mac, more watchful {shield}
Your phone now also hears if your Mac is unplugged, if its lid is closed or
opened, or if the camera is covered. An alert that can't get through while
the Mac is offline is sent as soon as it's back.

# Listen while you watch {iphone}
While watching the camera on your phone, tap Listen to hear the room. Your
Mac shows its microphone light while you do, and it's never on by itself.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Delete guard pictures on your phone, or all at once under Settings › Guard.
- If the camera's cover is left shut, you're told it can't see anything.
- Help has a section on Guard this Mac.
- Your Mac says when a phone starts watching its camera.
